criterion: ROADMAP dated proposal P10 (2026-10-21): a sphere-field showcase and regression scene covering the material set, with a reference image, the raster frame's error against path tracer v3 stated against a bound written first, and frame times.
written: 2026-10-21, before any sphere-field code and before any run

design.scene: 24 spheres (radius 0.55) on a ground plane (y = -1.6, a rough grey dielectric) in four rows at depths 6 to 13.5 m, seen by a level camera at the origin looking along -z (so world space is the lighting reference's view space). Twelve looks, each twice with a second parameter: gold, copper, red plastic, white ceramic, car paint (clearcoat), velvet (sheen), brushed steel (anisotropy), thin film (iridescence 300 and 700 nm), thin glass, volume glass with absorption, a warm emissive sphere, and a near-mirror / black rubber pair. Lit by the gallery's procedural sky cube and a low warm sun (directional light).
design.where: gallery::buildField in src/renderer/gallery_field.cpp beside the material gallery (same Gallery type, so the float64 shading, the GPU pbr_shade pass and the path-traced comparison all apply); raw_native_cli material-gallery --field
design.thin_film_note: Thin-film iridescence is already a material term (KHR_materials_iridescence, pbr.hpp, path tracer v3); the field exercises it at two thicknesses rather than adding a term.

f1_coverage.what: every one of the 12 looks and the ground appear in the frame at 256 x 160
f1_coverage.bound: each covers at least 100 fully covered pixels

f2_regression.what: tests/test_sphere_field.cpp: the CPU frame at 96 x 60, 1 sample a pixel, hashed (FNV-1a over the exposed floats) and pinned per compiler family (GCC, MSVC), recorded on this branch's first build
f2_regression.bound: the hash equals the pinned value

f3_gpu_parity.what: the GPU pbr_shade pass against the float64 frame on WARP and lavapipe (CI), and the RTX 4090 (D3D12, under the shared GPU lock)
f3_gpu_parity.bound: the gallery's v3 bound: rmse_exposed at most 5e-4, max_abs_exposed at most 0.05
f3_gpu_parity.prediction: holds on all three now that the table read uses the polynomial acos

f4_pt_error.what: material-gallery --field --pt: the raster frame against path tracer v3 at the raster's own sample points, 256 x 160, 2 x 2 samples a pixel
f4_pt_error.bound: relative RMSE at most 0.6 (the hero's bound); coverage agreement at least 0.99; the control (environment x pi) must exceed 0.6
f4_pt_error.prediction: misses, moderate confidence: the raster has no shadows, so the spheres' contact shadows and the sun's cast shadows on the ground are pure error; I expect 0.6 to 0.9, carried by the ground

f5_frame_times.what: wall time of the float64 CPU frame, the GPU shading pass (RTX 4090 and WARP) and the path-traced reference, at 256 x 160
f5_frame_times.prediction: GPU pass under 10 ms on the 4090 for the shading dispatch; the measured wall time includes table and environment upload

does_not_prove: That the raster is right where it differs from light transport (f4 measures how far it is); real-time frame rates of a full renderer (only the shading pass is timed); anything about a laptop GPU (none available).
